lessons.title: Learning the Alphabet
lessons.description: Introduction to the English alphabet and basic pronunciation.
lessons.objective: Learn the basic letters and sounds of the English alphabet.

grammar_introduction.explanation: Learn the English alphabet and how to pronounce each letter.

practice.sentence: ___ (A) is the first letter of the alphabet.

translation.sentence: Write the first letter of the alphabet.

examples_generated_by_chatgpt.sentence: The letter after B is C.

repetition.sentence: Repeat after me: A, B, C.

recording.sentence: Say the alphabet from A to F.

suggestion_of_formulation.sentence: You can say 'A is for Apple' to remember the letter.

improvement_tips.tip: Practice pronouncing each letter slowly to get the correct sound.

review_materials.content: A chart of all letters with images.

lessons.title: Saying Hello
lessons.description: Learn how to greet people and introduce yourself in English.
lessons.objective: Be able to greet others and introduce yourself in simple English.

verbs.example: He greets everyone with a smile.
Let me introduce you to my friend.

grammar_introduction.explanation: Learn basic greetings and how to introduce yourself in English.

translation.sentence: How do you say 'hola' in English?

comprehension_questions.question: What do you say when you meet someone?
What do you say when you leave?

listening_practice.transcription: Hello, my name is John. Goodbye, see you later.

evaluation.feedback: Good use of greetings and introductions.

suggestion_of_formulation.sentence: You can also say 'hi' instead of 'hello'.

improvement_tips.tip: Practice saying greetings in front of a mirror to build confidence.

review_materials.content: A set of cards with common greetings.
Worksheet to practice writing and saying greetings.

lessons.title: Talking About Yourself
lessons.description: Practice using personal pronouns to talk about yourself and others.
lessons.objective: Learn how to use personal pronouns to talk about yourself and others.

native_expression.example: Knock knock. Who's there? It's me!

grammar_introduction.explanation: Learn to use personal pronouns in sentences.

listening_practice.transcription: I am a student. You are my friend.

suggestion_of_formulation.sentence: You can say 'I am a student' instead of 'Me student'.

improvement_tips.tip: Practice using personal pronouns in everyday conversations.

review_materials.content: A chart showing all personal pronouns.
Worksheet to practice using pronouns in sentences.

lessons.title: Counting to Ten
lessons.description: Learn the numbers from 1 to 10 and how to use them in sentences.
lessons.objective: Learn how to count from 1 to 10 and use numbers in sentences.

native_expression.example: Don't worry, you can count on it.

grammar_introduction.explanation: Learn the numbers from 1 to 10 and how to use them in sentences.

comprehension_questions.question: How many apples do I have?

listening_practice.transcription: One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten.

repetition.sentence: Repeat after me: One, two, three.

suggestion_of_formulation.sentence: You can count objects to practice numbers.

improvement_tips.tip: Practice counting objects around you to get comfortable with numbers.

review_materials.content: A chart of numbers 1 to 10 with images.

lessons.title: Days and Months
lessons.grammar_topic: Days of the Week and Months of the Year
lessons.description: Familiarize yourself with the days of the week and months of the year.
lessons.objective: Learn the days of the week and months of the year.

grammar_introduction.explanation: Learn the days of the week and months of the year.

practice.sentence: ___ (January) is the first month of the year.

examples_generated_by_chatgpt.sentence: December is the last month of the year.

listening_practice.transcription: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday.

recording.sentence: Name the days of the week.

evaluation.feedback: Great job naming the days of the week.

suggestion_of_formulation.sentence: You can say 'TGIF' to express excitement for Friday.

improvement_tips.tip: Practice saying the days of the week out loud to improve pronunciation.

review_materials.content: A chart showing all days and months.
Worksheet to practice writing days and months.
